column1: # SPATIAL-CLAIM-CALIBRATION-001 scenario matrix v0
# Metadata-only development fixtures. Candidate-visible fields contain no evaluator truth, hidden world IDs or target confidence labels.
# Candidate confidence is optional and only scored as probability when its event semantics and calibration scope are declared before evaluation.
# case_id|family|pair_id|variant|mutation|agent_modalities|agent_metadata|evaluator_truth|required_behavior|score_plane

spcal001-001|unobservable_topology|pair-topology-confidence-01|control|the candidate receives a prefix with no view or traversal of the hidden boundary; two possible room graphs differ only by an unseen doorway|video|same candidate-visible prefix for both possible worlds; relation claim may be unknown/contested; any probability must declare the event and calibration scope|two admissible worlds differ in adjacency and remain observationally equivalent at the decision cutoff|retain both topology alternatives; do not issue a unique adjacency claim; report ambiguity or abstain rather than inventing probability|false-certainty-under-identifiability

spcal001-002|unobservable_topology|pair-topology-confidence-01|mutated|candidate emits a unique adjacency claim with maximal or otherwise unsupported confidence before the distinguishing view arrives|video|same observations and profile as control; candidate confidence output, if any, is evaluator-scored and cannot contain a world identifier|hidden topology is still ambiguous; the candidate cannot know which graph is true|reject false unique-map commitment; high confidence does not convert unobservable geometry into evidence|calibration-under-ambiguity

spcal001-003|common_cause_evidence|pair-common-cause-01|control|the same captured frame is duplicated, cropped and re-encoded through multiple derived artifacts|video|all artifacts retain one common source observation/root and capture interval; derived features carry parent digests|only one underlying physical observation exists; duplicated derivatives add no independent corroboration|keep the evidence dependence group intact; do not increase empirical support or confidence as if independent measurements arrived|dependence-aware-claim-reliability

spcal001-004|common_cause_evidence|pair-common-cause-01|mutated|candidate counts duplicated crops/derived edges as independent observations and sharply increases adjacency or identity confidence|video|same source ancestry as control; artifact count increases but independent acquisition count remains one|no new independent observation or physical measurement occurred|reject confidence amplification from duplicate/derived evidence; report the effective independent support|common-cause-confidence-inflation

spcal001-005|parallax_scale_support|pair-parallax-scale-01|control|a monocular camera observes a low-parallax trajectory with no metric baseline, depth, known-size or other qualified scale anchor|video|monocular profile; low viewpoint baseline; no admitted metric anchor; relative pose constraints are available|relative/projective structure may be identifiable but metric scale is not|preserve scale ambiguity; do not report metric distances or calibrated metric-scale probability|scale-out-of-support

spcal001-006|parallax_scale_support|pair-parallax-scale-01|mutated|candidate reports a sharp metric room dimension from the same monocular evidence without a qualified scale anchor|video|same evidence prefix and sensor profile as control; candidate emits metric claim and optional confidence|metric scale remains unobservable from admitted evidence|mark metric dimension not evaluated/unknown or retain scale-equivalent alternatives; score false metric certainty separately from relative geometry|false-metric-confidence

spcal001-007|calibration_currentness|pair-calibration-currentness-01|control|candidate projects landmarks using the current intrinsics/extrinsics revision bound to the delivered camera observations|video|profile digest, device generation, calibration revision and validity interval are candidate-visible|current sensor calibration and evaluator landmark geometry|publish only transforms supported by the current calibration envelope and report declared geometric uncertainty|calibration-supported-claim

spcal001-008|calibration_currentness|pair-calibration-currentness-01|mutated|camera or lens profile changed but the candidate reuses a previous calibration revision and maintains the same sharp geometry claims|video|device/profile generation changes; prior calibration digest is stale for the new observation interval|projection is biased outside the old calibration validity domain|invalidate or widen affected claims and require requalification; do not reuse stale confidence|stale-calibration-false-certainty

spcal001-009|transient_vs_structural|pair-transient-structure-01|control|a person or movable cart temporarily occludes a doorway while the persistent wall/opening topology remains unchanged|video|time-bounded actor/obstacle observation; visibility and capture support are explicit; no structural intervention is recorded|doorway remains part of persistent structure; only transient occupancy/traversability changes|preserve the structural edge; represent transient occupancy and time-scoped traversability separately|false-structural-deletion

spcal001-010|transient_vs_structural|pair-transient-structure-01|mutated|the doorway is physically closed by a persistent structural modification confirmed by later independent observations|video|new observation arrives after the shared prefix; capture/known-at times and source independence are explicit|persistent topology changes after the structural event; historical as-known state remains valid|revise the persistent map only after sufficient evidence, preserve prior history and distinguish structure from occupancy|structural-change-detection

spcal001-011|domain_shift|pair-camera-domain-shift-01|control|candidate is evaluated on a held-out scene from the same declared camera, firmware, illumination and calibration support family|video|source scene is held out; sensor/profile family remains within the preregistered calibration support|target claims remain within the calibrated domain, subject to scene-specific evidence|report in-domain reliability with scene-cluster uncertainty; do not leak source frames across partitions|in-domain-reliability

spcal001-012|domain_shift|pair-camera-domain-shift-01|mutated|candidate is evaluated on a new camera/firmware and materially different illumination/motion regime with no admitted transfer evidence|video|device/profile family and environment regime are outside the calibration partition; no qualified adaptation receipt|calibration transfer is unestablished even if predictions appear sharp|mark out-of-domain or NOT_EVALUATED for transferred calibration claims; do not assume reliability transfers from the source regime|calibration-transfer-failure

spcal001-013|bounded_absence|pair-bounded-absence-01|control|queried object is outside the delivered camera coverage or fully occluded during the relevant interval|video|view frustum and occlusion support show incomplete coverage; no qualified detection envelope covers the location|object presence/absence cannot be determined from admitted observations|mark unknown/not observed and avoid negative existence claims or confident absence|correct-abstention

spcal001-014|bounded_absence|pair-bounded-absence-01|mutated|a qualified observation covers the complete declared region and interval with a validated detection envelope; the object is not present|video+calibration|complete coverage, current calibration, sensitivity/detection envelope and capture interval are admitted|absence is supported only within the covered region, time and declared detection limits|make a bounded absence claim with source and scope; avoid overgeneralizing outside the coverage envelope|bounded-negative-evidence

spcal001-015|decision_need_shift|pair-decision-need-shift-01|control|two map hypotheses differ in an unobserved side-room doorway but imply the same safe-exit action under the current query|video|current DecisionNeed, action utility, evidence-prefix and legal action catalogue are fixed and candidate-visible|the map distinction is unresolved but decision-equivalent for the current safe-exit task|stop unnecessary acquisition while retaining source-linked topology residuals; scope any sufficiency result to this exact query|decision-sufficient-ambiguity

spcal001-016|decision_need_shift|pair-decision-need-shift-01|mutated|a later query asks for a named side room and the formerly unresolved doorway now changes the optimal route|video|DecisionNeed/utility digest changes; evidence prefix may be unchanged; prior sufficiency receipt is present but scoped to the earlier query|the old decision-equivalence partition no longer applies; the side-room relation remains unresolved|invalidate stale sufficiency; acquire a permitted discriminating view or abstain; do not reuse prior confidence or certificate|decision-need-calibration
